meta.name: pgvector-semantic-search
meta.description:
Use this skill for setting up vector similarity search with pgvector for AI/ML embeddings, RAG applications, or semantic search.

**Trigger when user asks to:**
- Store or search vector embeddings in PostgreSQL
- Set up semantic search, similarity search, or nearest neighbor search
- Create HNSW or IVFFlat indexes for vectors
- Implement RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) with PostgreSQL
- Optimize pgvector performance, recall, or memory usage
- Use binary quantization for large vector datasets

**Keywords:** pgvector, embeddings, semantic search, vector similarity, HNSW, IVFFlat, halfvec, cosine distance, nearest neighbor, RAG, LLM, AI search

Covers: halfvec storage, HNSW index configuration (m, ef_construction, ef_search), quantization strategies, filtered search, bulk loading, and performance tuning.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你用 PostgreSQL 的 pgvector 扩展做语义搜索。它会指导你创建表、存储向量、建索引，并写出查询语句，让数据库根据含义而非关键词找到最相似的内容。
howto.when: 当你提到“语义搜索”、“向量相似度”、“RAG”或“pgvector”等关键词，或者要求设置 HNSW/IVFFlat 索引、优化性能时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 pgvector 设置语义搜索，存储 1536 维的嵌入向量。
say.note: Claude 会给出建表、建索引和查询的 SQL 示例。

say.text: 如何为我的向量数据创建 HNSW 索引并调优 ef_search？
say.note: Claude 会解释参数并给出设置命令。

say.text: 我的向量数据集很大，怎么用二进制量化节省内存？
say.note: Claude 会展示带重排序的二进制量化方案。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you set up semantic search using the pgvector extension in PostgreSQL. It guides you through creating tables, storing vectors, building indexes, and writing queries so the database finds the most similar content by meaning rather than keywords.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like 'semantic search', 'vector similarity', 'RAG', or 'pgvector', or ask to set up HNSW/IVFFlat indexes or optimize performance.

say_en.text: Help me set up semantic search with pgvector, storing 1536-dimensional embeddings.
say_en.note: Claude will provide SQL examples for table creation, indexing, and querying.

say_en.text: How do I create an HNSW index for my vector data and tune ef_search?
say_en.note: Claude will explain parameters and give setting commands.

say_en.text: My vector dataset is large; how can I use binary quantization to save memory?
say_en.note: Claude will show a binary quantization scheme with re-ranking.
